scope: Independent fresh-run Part 1 notebook, not a recovery notebook or certification of a full pretrained GPU run.

profile.minimum_hardware: One nominal 16-GB GPU; not pooled VRAM
profile.optional_draft_editor: Disabled because this non-required pass repeatedly failed validation and consumed additional calls in the supplied v5 log.
profile.required_citation_evaluation: Retained with exact-key schema-constrained classification from its first call.
profile.required_baseline_comparison: Retained: dense-only and hybrid multimodal on the separate 25-item candidate set.
profile.early_real_gpu_preflight: Chart answering and the citation judge run before the main GPU stages; not executed by the local CPU smoke.

local_validation.complete_control_flow_fixture: Passed actual generate_submission, strict answer-repair validation, both golden evaluation systems, exact-key citation judging, official CSV validator, publication and ZIP export with explicitly fictional software-test data/models. These fixture outputs are not lab results or quality scores.
local_validation.embedded_checks: Also run retrieval, quality-control, evidence-review, constrained-decoding, tiny random-weight actual Qwen image forward and citation-judge tests before real inference. Tiny model tests are interface checks, not quality measurements.

limitations: No local CUDA GPU was available; CPU tests cannot prove the full 7B GPU run is error-free.
Setup/download times, GPU availability and account permissions remain external runtime dependencies.
Removing the optional editor changes the measured configuration and may change answer quality. No particular score or runtime is promised.
The prior reported v5 attempt exceeded 90 minutes. V6 must be measured anew; its timer includes setup and the experiment and explicitly notes remaining final display/export overhead.
Human ratings, team reference review, report/team details, final tagging and external submission remain separate.
